Question Choices: Select True or False of the statement "4/8 represents the same amount as 1/2" ~~True | False~~
Hints: Split each half into four equal pieces. Count how many pieces make the whole and how many make one half.
Solution: True. Split each half into 4 equal pieces: the whole then has 8 pieces and one half has 4. Thus 1/2 = 4/8.
